spin_discriminator_is_weak.consequence: in practice SPIN degenerates into a 6 h file-silence rule. That is still safe (6 h is 2.1x the measured tail) but it means v2's real improvement over v1 is the DEAD rule -- no CPU advance anywhere in the process tree and nothing in uninterruptible sleep -- not the SPIN rule
